title: Three Stars
text: Three Stars. Filters are a little expensive for the paper and plastic they are made of.

product_metadata.title: Bestway Type V Filter Cartridges
features: Genuine Bestway Flowclear #58168 replacement filter cartridge
Fits Bestway Flowclear 330 gallon per hour Model 58144 and 58144US filter pumps
DOES NOT FIT Model 58145 Bestway Flowclear filter pump
description: This is the genuine model 58168 replacement filter by Bestway, and will work for your Flowclear 330GPH filter pump. This cartridge filter measures 3.1" (8cm) high x 3.3" (8.3cm) in diameter, and are sold in packages of two. Please be advised that this filter cartridge does NOT fit Bestway 58145 Flowclear filter pump model.
